display_long_description:
This demo includes one of the four biomes from the full game — a first taste of the climb.

Bad Grip Club is a physics-based co-op climbing game for VR with crossplay. Climb a cartoonish mountain where physical grip and teamwork are your only hope.

VR IMMERSIVE CLIMBING

Feel the height and the risk of falling as you climb using your actual hands. Grab ledges, hold your grip, and recover from slips. If you do lose your hold, expect an immersive — and comical — crash landing!

CO-OP & CROSSPLAY

Team up with friends playing in VR or on a regular PC screen. Coordinate via voice chat, share items, and pull your friends up difficult cliffs. Just be careful not to accidentally drag your whole squad down into the abyss.

NEVER THE SAME CLIMB

Every climb feels fresh thanks to unpredictable physics and randomized loot along the way. Chug an energy drink for a stamina boost, use handy items to cross gaps, or take a break to roast sausages at camp.
